title: Dispatch: Resolve known rules-pack ambiguities as campaign rulings (attempt 1)
description:
Implements eshyra-jhpt.6 (read its spec + acceptance criteria). Base: eshyra-jhpt @ b79112c (main + .4 auditor parity + .5 'eshyra rules' CLI). Everything below is DECIDED; implement it, do not redesign. Amendment A2 (capability preflight) is OUT of scope here and tracked as a separate child under eshyra-jhpt.6.

WORKTREE / BRANCH: .worktrees/eshyra-jhpt.6.1 on branch eshyra-jhpt.6.1. npm ci already run.

CODE SURVEY (supervisor, exact pointers):
- Ambiguity metadata + active rulings: assembleCampaignRulesContext(db, campaignId, formattedPosition, resolveStrictCampaignRulesStack(db, resolveRulesPack?)) in packages/core/src/campaign/campaignContext.ts returns .ambiguities[{ambiguity: RulesAmbiguity {id, question, interpretations[{id, summary}], affects[], ...}, ruling?: CampaignRulingProjection, conflictingRulings[]}]. renderCampaignRulesSection(ctx) renders UNRESOLVED / Active ruling / CONFLICT lines and is shared by DM and auditor (.4).
- Bundled SRD ambiguity ids and interpretation ids (verified by running the built CLI): ambiguity:create-undead-ghast-wight-composition -> homogeneous-alternative | mixed-within-total; ambiguity:find-familiar-permanent-dismissal-after-zero-hp -> presence-required | active-link-sufficient; ambiguity:cube-of-force-same-face-duration-reset (leave to A2).
- Storage: createCampaignRule(db, rule, {currentPosition, validation:{ambiguity}}) in packages/core/src/campaign/campaignRuleStore.ts; ordinary rulings are prospective with effective ordinal > persisted current (getCurrentCampaignPosition(db, campaignId) in campaign/campaignPosition.ts; bootstrap current = {sessionId:'cli', turnId:'bootstrap', ordinal:0} when undefined — see packages/cli/src/rules.ts BOOTSTRAP constant and effectivePosition()). Ambiguity rulings for the same ambiguity may not overlap (store rejects). CampaignRule shape: see campaign/campaignRules.ts (provenance {kind:'ambiguity', ambiguityId, selectedInterpretationId}; origin 'player-approved'; temporalMode {mode:'prospective'}; supersededBy null; revokedPosition null).
- Tools: packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolRegistry.ts Tool {name, description, mutates, requiresExplicitAction?, inputSchema, run(args, ctx: ToolContext {db, campaignId, sessionId, turnId, at, resolveRulesPack?, ...})} with ok(data)/err(code,message,data?)/asRecord(args). Template: toolLookupRules.ts (mutates:false). Register in packages/core/src/orchestrator/tools.ts (import + add to the tool list near lookupRulesTool, line ~95). Executed calls reach the CLI as RunTurnResult.toolCalls: ExecutedToolCall[] {tool, args, result:{ok, data|code,message}} (orchestrator.ts RunTurnResult ~line 163).
- DM system prompt: buildSystemPrompt in packages/core/src/orchestrator/protocol.ts (tool guidance bullets around lines 240-330, e.g. the lookup_rules bullet at ~321). Auditor: packages/core/src/orchestrator/turnAuditor.ts buildAuditSystemPrompt (the .4 campaign-rules paragraph at ~line 300) and AUDIT_POLICY (~line 155).
- CLI play loop: packages/cli/src/playTurnLoop.ts turnLoop(): after deps.runTurn(...) resolves with result.ok it writes result.narration (line ~125). deps.io: CliIO {write(line), prompt(question) -> Promise<string|undefined>} (packages/cli/src/playTypes.ts). Tests fake deps.runTurn (PlayDeps.runTurn is injectable) — see packages/cli/test/play.test.ts for the harness.
- CLI rules command: packages/cli/src/rules.ts (parseArgs/flag/requiredFlag/withCampaign/validateAmbiguity/contextAmbiguity helpers; dispatcher runRulesCommand; USAGE string). Tests: packages/cli/test/rules.test.ts (invoke(dbPath, args) harness).
- Root export boundary: CLI imports only '@eshyra/core' (packages/cli/test/internalBoundary.test.ts). Promote the two new core functions below to packages/core/src/index.ts (next to the .5 block) and also export them from internal.ts.
- Scripted model doubles for orchestrator tests: packages/core/test/orchestrator.test.ts ScriptedModel (fenced tool protocol replies) and StructuredScriptedModel (native toolCalls) — copy an existing test that scripts a lookup_rules call to see the exact reply format.

DESIGN (decided):
1. Core service packages/core/src/campaign/ambiguityResolution.ts:
   - export function lookupCampaignAmbiguity(db, {campaignId, ambiguityId, position: CampaignPosition, resolveRulesPack?}): {ambiguity: RulesAmbiguity, status: 'unresolved'|'resolved'|'conflicting', ruling?: CampaignRulingProjection, conflictingRulings: CampaignRulingProjection[]}. Unknown id -> throw CampaignRuleError('unknown ambiguity <id>; known ambiguity ids: a, b, c') (sorted). Uses assembleCampaignRulesContext at formatCampaignPosition(position) — NO new store, no pack write.
   - export function recordAmbiguityRuling(db, {campaignId, ambiguityId, interpretationId, prose?, currentPosition, effectiveOrdinal?, sessionId?, resolveRulesPack?}): {created: boolean, rule: CampaignRule}. If an active ruling for that ambiguity exists at the position immediately after current -> return {created:false, rule: existing} WITHOUT writing (idempotent; 'existing active ruling prevents re-prompting'). Else validate interpretationId against ambiguity.interpretations (unknown -> CampaignRuleError listing the known interpretation ids), build the ruling: ruleIdentity 'ruling:<ambiguityId without the "ambiguity:" prefix>:<effective ordinal>', ruleKind 'ruling', origin 'player-approved', provenance {kind:'ambiguity', ambiguityId, selectedInterpretationId}, effectivePosition {...currentPosition, ordinal: effectiveOrdinal ?? currentPosition.ordinal + 1}, temporalMode prospective, scope 'rules-ambiguity', governingRecordKeys = ambiguity.affects (non-empty; if the pack's affects is empty use ['ambiguity:<id>']), prose = provided ?? `${ambiguity.question} Ruling: ${interpretation.summary}`; persist via createCampaignRule with validation {ambiguity}. Return what was persisted.
2. Tool packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolRequestAmbiguityRuling.ts: name 'request_ambiguity_ruling', mutates:false, args {ambiguityId: string}. run: lookupCampaignAmbiguity at the turn's current persisted position (getCurrentCampaignPosition(ctx.db, ctx.campaignId) — the turn's own row exists because runTurn resolves the position first). Returns ok({ambiguityId, question, interpretations:[{id, summary}], status, ruling: {ruleIdentity, selectedInterpretationId, prose} | null}); unknown id -> err('unknown_ambiguity', message, {knownAmbiguityIds}). Description tells the DM: call when an outcome depends on an ambiguity marked UNRESOLVED in Campaign Rules; then narrate the published uncertainty, present the interpretations neutrally, and tell the player they will be asked to choose; never choose yourself; if status is 'resolved', apply the ruling.
3. Prompts: add ONE bullet to buildSystemPrompt tool guidance (protocol.ts) stating the above. Add ONE line to the auditor's campaign-rules paragraph (turnAuditor.ts): a candidate that asserts a definite outcome for an ambiguity listed as UNRESOLVED without an active ruling must be rejected, reason citing the ambiguity id; a candidate that surfaces the uncertainty and defers to the player is acceptable.
4. CLI play loop: new file packages/cli/src/playRulings.ts exporting async function offerAmbiguityRulings(deps: PlayDeps, db: Db, campaignId: string, toolCalls: readonly ExecutedToolCall[]): Promise<void>. For each executed 'request_ambiguity_ruling' call with result.ok and data.status === 'unresolved' (dedupe by ambiguityId): io.write the question and numbered interpretations, io.prompt('Choose an interpretation number, or press Enter to leave it unresolved: '); Enter/undefined/invalid -> write 'Left unresolved.' and create nothing; a valid number -> recordAmbiguityRuling with currentPosition = getCurrentCampaignPosition(db, campaignId) and write 'Ruling <identity> recorded (<interpretationId>); takes effect from turn <ordinal>.' Errors -> write the message, create nothing. Call it from turnLoop right after deps.io.write(result.narration). (The ruling is prospective, so the NEXT turn's DM and auditor contexts carry it; that is the spec's 'prospectively active'.)
5. CLI rules command additions (packages/cli/src/rules.ts): 'rules ambiguities [campaign-id]' lists every ambiguity id with status (unresolved/resolved:<ruleIdentity>/conflicting) and its interpretation ids; 'rules resolve <ambiguity-id> --interpretation <id> [--prose <text>] [--effective <ordinal>] [campaign-id]' calls recordAmbiguityRuling and prints the same confirmation shape as 'add' (identity, effective ordinal, provenance, takes effect from turn N), or 'already resolved by <identity>' with exit 0 when created:false. Update USAGE.
6. Pack immutability: never write to the pack; tests assert the resolved stack's ambiguity record is unchanged (deep-equal before/after) and that no row other than campaign_rule changed.

EVIDENCE (each must FAIL against b79112c; report observed counts):
E1 packages/core/test/ambiguityResolution.test.ts: for create-undead, recording homogeneous-alternative in one db and mixed-within-total in another both persist one ruling with correct provenance/identity/effective position; find-familiar both interpretations; unknown ambiguity and unknown interpretation messages list the known ids; recording twice returns created:false and the same rule (one row); lookup status transitions unresolved -> resolved at the next position and stays unresolved at the current position; assembleCampaignRulesContext at the next position shows the ruling, and renderCampaignRulesSection output is byte-identical for the DM path (renderContextMessage section) and the auditor path (buildAuditUserMessage section) — reuse .4's parity helpers; pack record unchanged.
E2 packages/core/test/orchestrator.test.ts (or a new toolRequestAmbiguityRuling.test.ts): a ScriptedModel turn that calls request_ambiguity_ruling for create-undead gets status 'unresolved' with both interpretations; after recordAmbiguityRuling, the next turn's call returns 'resolved' with the ruling; unknown id -> err with knownAmbiguityIds; the tool is registered (registry.list() contains it) and mutates:false; the DM system prompt and auditor system prompt contain the new guidance.
E3 packages/cli/test/playRulings.test.ts: with a fake runTurn returning an ok result whose toolCalls include an unresolved request, choosing '2' records the ruling (assert via getCampaignRule) and prints the confirmation; pressing Enter creates nothing; an invalid number creates nothing; a 'resolved' status prompts nothing; two calls for the same ambiguity prompt once.
E4 packages/cli/test/rules.test.ts: 'rules ambiguities' lists the three bundled ids with statuses; 'rules resolve' creates the ruling and re-running reports already resolved with exit 0; unknown interpretation lists known ids.

VERIFICATION: npm run verify:worktree BEFORE committing; report pass/skip counts and confirm worktree-local resolution. Do not modify campaignRuleStore.ts/campaignRules.ts admission logic or the rules-pack data.
